_comment: Hand-labelled glossary relevance for the tests/eval contracts. A glossary term (app/rag/glossary_data/glossary.json) is relevant to a clause if the clause uses the term, its word family (indemnify -> Indemnification, liabilities -> Liability), or the legal concept it names: ending on notice without a reason -> Termination for Convenience; ending for breach, non-payment or misconduct -> Termination for Cause; 'governed by the laws of' -> Choice of Law; named courts -> Venue; 'beyond reasonable control' -> Force Majeure; 'if capable of remedy, not remedied within 30 days' -> Cure Period; 'breach of this Agreement / of Clause 8' -> Breach of Contract (Material Breach instead where it says material). Clauses not listed should get no glossary terms. History: the first labels (written before scoring) used only the term's word family; after the first scoring run the concept rule above was adopted and applied to all clauses, adding 14 labels, and one word-family label missed at first (services 8: "prompt notice" -> Notice) was added. The embedding search scored precision 26% / recall 36% on the first labels.
dev_comment: documents: the tests/eval contracts, keyed by clause heading. The patterns in glossary.json were written against these, so they are a regression check, not evidence of accuracy.
heldout_comment: heldout: real CUAD contracts from tests/eval/rag_gold.json, keyed by clause number, labelled by reading with the same rule before the pattern matcher was run on them. Blind result before any change: pattern matcher precision 81% / recall 91%; the old embedding search 25% / 42%. Afterwards one labelling error was corrected (distributor preamble: 'The Distributor represents that' -> Representation) and the patterns were fixed for 'as amended' (a statute), 'limited liability company', filing labels like 'Exhibit h(2)', 'without cause' and 'change or modification of this Agreement' — so this split is no longer held out. The signature section after the last clause is its own block, keyed 'Signatures' (2026-11-07); cuad_sponsorship's 'In Witness Whereof' moved there from clause 10, which used to swallow it.
